argv: MATCH (c:Concept) WHERE c.name =~ '(?i).*retention.*' OR any(a IN c.aliases WHERE a =~ '(?i).*retention.*') OPTIONAL MATCH (c)<-[:VARIANT_OF]-(v:Concept)-[:MEASURED_BY]->(m:Metric) RETURN c, v, m

c.name: Customer Retention
c.definition: The degree to which customers keep transacting or stay active over time. Ambiguous: pick a variant.

v.name: Repeat-purchase retention
v.definition: Share of customers who purchase again within a fixed window.

m.name: Repeat-purchase rate (90d)
m.description: Share of customers with a second purchase within 90 days of their first.

c.name: Customer Retention
c.definition: The degree to which customers keep transacting or stay active over time. Ambiguous: pick a variant.

v.name: Loyalty-member activity retention
v.definition: Share of loyalty members active in a rolling window.

m.name: Member active rate (30d)
m.description: Share of loyalty members with any activity in the last 30 days.
